items.meta_title: VPN Protocols: UDP, TCP and QUIC | VpnHood!
items.meta_description: Switch between UDP, TCP and QUIC to suit the network you are on, and block QUIC when it gets in the way of video. Available in VpnHood!
items.title: Protocols
items.lead: A VPN protocol defines how your data travels between your device and the server. Switch between them to suit the network you are on.
items.shot_alt: The Protocols screen in the VpnHood! app
items.platforms: Android, iOS, Windows and Linux. QUIC availability varies by platform.
items.pick_desc: All three are encrypted. What changes is the speed, and which networks let them through.
items.tcp_good: Reliable and stable, and it gets through where UDP does not.
items.quic_good: A modern protocol over UDP, fast and reliable where it is allowed.
items.quic_limit: Some networks restrict it, and it is not on every platform.
items.when_desc: Switch when a network is slow or refusing to connect. Try UDP first for speed and TCP when something is in the way. You will find Protocol on the app's home screen.
items.cost_desc: Nothing. The protocol switches on the live connection, so you can try another the moment one underperforms without dropping the tunnel.
items.block_desc: In Cloak Mode, Block QUIC in other apps makes them fall back to TCP, which can improve video playback. Block UDP in other apps stops all their UDP except DNS, but voice and video calls and games that need UDP stop working.
items.more_how_desc: What happens to your traffic on its way from your device to the server.
